title: nmrForge: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: nmrForge automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE, records parameters and quality-control decisions, and provides spectrum viewing and peak localization. Version 1.0.6 with API 1.1.2 adds per-reference window and baseline optimization score tables and optional explicit candidate pools. Each supplied pool replaces its corresponding defaults, and the highest-scoring valid candidate is used to build the reference. The 38-column peak-table contract is retained. The release includes source code and a Linux AppImage. Processing methods, four-path comparisons and their limitations are documented in the repository.
